# FFT phase

Fast Fourier Transform (FFT): get phases from coefficients

## Usage

``` r
fft_phase(coefficients)
```

## Arguments

- coefficients:

  num. The Fourier coefficients.

## Value

\\b\_{n}\\ array of phases.

## Examples

``` r

fft_rfft(temperatures = hobo$t_hobo[1:(24 * 5)]) |>
  fft_phase()
```
